study.question: After removing action-codebook learning and exposing exact historical task membership, does event-specific action binding improve click AUC beyond per-history membership-conditional action composition, and does that contrast depend on membership initialization?
study.hypothesis: The near match of native full and conditional counts (0.6688473939 vs0.6688759965) suggests event binding may be dispensable, but different action-table update exposure and unavailable heterogeneity diagnostics prevent attribution. Blocking action-table gradients removes one optimization difference. Crossing full/conditional composition with zero/action-RMS membership initialization tests whether the previously initialization-sensitive full/blind gap persists for an alignment-removal contrast. This is a follow-up hypothesis, not a new architecture or established information benefit.

Inherits the standalone implementation unchanged except the action-replacement helper/diagnostic and accepted mode/defaults. Full controls compute the same helper but return original actions.

Archived primary abstract inspected for target-conditioned local activation. DIN motivates the inherited pooling reference; this is a conditional action ablation, not an exact paper reproduction or novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add membership_counts_only mode: FP32 anchored residual means over valid events within each row and exact four-mask stratum, broadcast back to original positions before every summary/scorer; item fields, event order and masks remain untouched. First-event anchors cancel algebraically and guarantee exact identity for homogeneous strata. Compute the helper in both full and conditional cells to match its kernel work. No parameter or buffer is added. Cross this single representation intervention with the two already evaluated membership initializations.
predictions: If event alignment carries stable utility, full-minus-conditional click AUC should exceed0.0002 at both initializations, conditional on nonzero within-row/stratum action variation.
If conditional composition suffices, full and conditional AUC will be descriptively within0.0002 while conditional may exceed the prior blind control; this does not establish statistical equivalence.

If masks determine actions globally on observed training support, every within-row stratum is homogeneous and full/conditional representations are exact identities; alignment is not experimentally identifiable by this replacement.
A contrast reversal across initializers would support initialization dependence, with absolute degradation reported separately.
falsifiers: No within-row exact-mask-stratum action variation makes an alignment interpretation inadmissible; missing diagnostics remain missing, not evidence of variation.
If preflight cannot reproduce the two inherited full cells at a shared state, reject the implementation bridge before mechanism interpretation.
Consistent conditional superiority by more than0.0002 undermines the hypothesis that full event binding is necessary in this implementation.

If global action/membership counts show one action per occupied membership pattern, claim no additional action information on that observed support; quality differences from blind would be parameterization/optimization evidence.

Differences outside runtime/noise tolerance, shape/mask failures, trainable parameter mismatches, codebook changes despite blocked gradients, or hard resource exhaustion invalidate the planned causal comparison rather than count as scientific success.
alternative_explanations: Conditional averaging removes within-stratum action variance and changes summary/scorer geometry as well as event binding; it is not a pure permutation.
Only one frozen training seed is authorized here; deterministic bridge repeats are not independent repetitions.
The action channel is a fixed random codebook and membership is trainable: this tests the inherited parameterization, not every possible action-blind representation.
Floating-point reductions and the inherited surrogate VJP can amplify small trajectory changes; homogeneous groups are made exact identities.
Per-row conditional action histograms can carry user/history composition without requiring event alignment.
Zero/action-RMS initializer effects may reflect added channel scale or code geometry; the factorial detects dependence without isolating every geometric cause.
Official offline delayed-feedback visibility and auxiliary category/brand labels limit production and attribution claims.

host_preflight: Before training, use the authorized host only. Host must explicitly call optional conditional_action_diagnostics and membership_diagnostics over training support, aggregating counts by sum and max_abs_channel_difference by max. There is no guaranteed automatic collector; if unavailable record not_collected and forbid alignment claims.

At the same host seed, compare full_frozen_zero_bridge to history_g0_r0088_full_frozen_zero_bridge and full_frozen_initialized_bridge to history_g0_r0088_full_frozen_initialized: identical learned tensors/buffers, RNG state and forward outputs at shared state; compare primary/private gradients, surrogate context VJP and running-state updates on occupied/empty inputs. Full controls should reproduce their committed training outcomes; unexplained drift invalidates reused quality controls.

Exercise homogeneous and heterogeneous action IDs within exact membership groups, mixed/empty/padded histories, singleton groups and permuted feature_map label order. In homogeneous groups require bitwise full/conditional channel equality; for heterogeneous groups compare FP32 means to explicit grouped sums, test within-group action permutation invariance of means and preserve target action/padding.

At fixed weights, changing historical action alignment within a stratum may change full but must not change conditional composition beyond declared FP32 reduction tolerance. Changing a target action or masked action must not affect predictions. Do not change host inputs or scorers for training.

Forward/backward all tasks: finite probabilities [B,1], finite loss, no action-codebook data gradient in any cell, membership gradient present when supported, identical allocated/gradient-active parameter schemas; checkpoint state round-trip; confirm no helper RNG/state mutation.

Record actual parameter counts, allocated GPU seconds if supported, train/wall times, examples, memory, all-task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, full validation sample identity, throughput and batch latency. New full-vs-conditional timing uses common helper; comparison to old incumbent/blind is a different cost view. No equal-compute efficiency claim without measurement.
